title: Fix Admin Authorization for Comment List Creation

requirements.summary: Fix AdminComments.tsx to use authenticated actor for all comment list mutations
acceptanceCriteria: AdminComments.tsx retrieves and uses the authenticated actor for all mutation calls
Creating, renaming, deleting, and modifying comment lists from the Admin Panel completes without authorization errors
The pattern matches how AdminLiveList.tsx and AdminSettings.tsx obtain and pass the authenticated actor

file_operations.description: Update AdminComments.tsx to use the authenticated actor from useActor hook for all comment list mutation operations (createCommentList, renameCommentList, deleteCommentList, addTemplatesToList, toggleListLock). Follow the same pattern used in AdminLiveList.tsx and AdminSettings.tsx where the authenticated actor is retrieved via useActor and passed to mutation hooks. Ensure all mutation calls that interact with admin-gated backend functions use the authenticated actor rather than the anonymous identity. This resolves the 'Unauthorized: Only admins can add comment lists' error by ensuring proper authentication credentials are sent with all admin operations.
